en.name: Bohan Su
headline: World models
Multimodal foundation models
en.intro: I am a Software Engineering undergraduate at Wuhan University. My research experience includes person re-identification and scientific reasoning graph extraction, alongside projects in agents and robotics.
en.availability: Open to research collaborations and RA opportunities
en.contact_body: I am interested in research collaborations and research assistant opportunities in world models and multimodal foundation models. Please contact me by email.

works.title: Reliability-Aware 3D Geometric Injection for Universal Person Re-identification
works.body: UniGeo uses monocular 3D body geometry as complementary evidence for person re-identification. A reliability-aware gate limits the influence of low-confidence geometric estimates. Evaluation covers comparisons, ablations, and perturbation tests on nine benchmarks.

figure.alt: UniGeo framework: visual and 3D structural streams combined through reliability-aware gating.
figure.caption: UniGeo framework
figure.open_label: View the UniGeo framework at full size

works.title: PEARL: Auditable Repair for Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction
works.body: PEARL combines structural constraints with evaluator feedback to identify and repair structural and semantic issues in scientific reasoning graphs, with records that support inspection and tracing.

figure.alt: PEARL pipeline for graph extraction, structural and semantic repair, and re-evaluation.
figure.caption: PEARL framework
figure.open_label: View the PEARL framework at full size

works.title: Appearance Variations in Person Re-Identification: A Survey
works.body: This survey organizes person re-identification research around short-term perturbations, long-term appearance changes, and compound variations. It examines methods and evaluation protocols through appearance robustness and generalization.

projects.title: SmartPhone Battery: The Moment of Depletion
projects.body: Combined a physical battery model with ECM-EKF and physics-informed neural network solvers. Evaluation covered eight types of data and more than 120,000 time steps, with 1.24% SOC RMSE and 8.7% TTE MAPE.

projects.title: A2A Multi-Agent System
projects.body: Implemented protocol adaptation, streaming responses, context propagation, fallback handling, and logging on Holos and A2A v0.3.0. Integrated travel-planning and email-collaboration demos.
projects.recognition: Shanghai Innovation Institute, autumn camp project

projects.title: A4R: Guided Smartphone AI Assistant
projects.body: Co-designed a clarify–execute–verify workflow and built more than 150 interactions spanning six domains and 16 apps. In the China Unicom task evaluation, completion was 64.68% and effective guidance was 72.33%.
projects.recognition: Challenge Cup — Jiebang Guashuai Special Competition, second prize

projects.title: Xiaomi Quadruped Logistics System
projects.body: Contributed to system design, algorithm debugging, workflow optimization, and on-site testing, focusing on state transitions and action timing between delivery stages.

projects.title: Modular Robot System
projects.body: Implemented module coordination, bus arbitration, hot-plug discovery, and bus merging. Project tests reported 98.5% communication success and approximately 40% higher communication efficiency than the original design.
projects.recognition: National University IoT Design Competition, national first prize and final six
